steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend white into the dark sky
steps.load: load a little white on the brush
steps.new: color picks up the black canvas

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: brighten the light area
steps.load: load lightest white
steps.motion: blend outward from the light spot
steps.rule: brightest spot because the light sits behind the cloud

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: dab a small cloud with the fan corner
steps.load: load white back and forth on the fan

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend cloud base, flip upward
steps.motion: blend base with a small upward flip

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: pull off tape, cover horizon with black and blue
steps.load: rub a little black and blue along the tape
steps.rule: pulling the tape guarantees a straight horizon

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: loose sketch of the major wave
steps.motion: loose basic sketch, one big wave
steps.where: lower middle, crashing to the right
steps.rule: a loose sketch gives a guide to work from

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: rub distant wave bands
steps.load: load white on the fan
steps.motion: rub back and forth, let the brush rock
steps.new: picks up canvas color, darkens away from the light

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add big strong waves
steps.load: add a little more white

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: blend wave tops back
steps.motion: wipe fan nearly dry, blend back lightly
steps.rule: keeping the dark edge makes the wave settle out

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add white and blend the crashing part back
steps.load: a little more white on the fan
steps.where: the crashing part of the wave

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: scrub in translucent wave color
steps.load: white with the least touch of cad yellow
steps.motion: scrub in, work back, darker away from light
steps.rule: clean the brush between passes so old color does not drag in

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: barely graze and soften the wave
steps.motion: dry the brush, barely graze the canvas

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: shape the wave edge

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add white and yellow to the crashing wave
steps.load: white with the smallest touch of cad yellow
steps.motion: sweep up and over, spilling out

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: scrub in foam shadow
steps.load: blue with a touch of red, then white

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add white splashes on the upstroke
steps.load: white with the least touch of cad yellow, load both sides
steps.rule: the splash flicks off at the end of each upstroke

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: blend foam with tiny circular strokes

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: throw in a new wave and blend back
steps.load: load white
steps.where: lower middle, a new small wave

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: run a white splash up through the wave
steps.load: white only
steps.motion: run the splash up, blend back softly
steps.where: right side, up through the wave

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: lay foam highlights along the wave
steps.load: load white
steps.rule: foam helps form and shape the wave

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add thin edge highlights
steps.load: thin white with paint thinner, ink-like
steps.where: edge of the wave, following the angle

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: paint over bright spots to darken
steps.motion: paint over the bright bit a couple of times
steps.rule: the dark underneath blends it back

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add blue to darken the outer wave
steps.load: add phthalo blue into the light area
steps.rule: keeps the outer areas less bright

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: block in the big stone
steps.load: mix van dyke brown and dark sienna on the fan

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: dab bright red highlights on rocks
steps.load: least touch of bright red

steps.subject: water
steps.action: lift white water spilling down over the rocks
steps.load: white on the fan

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: block in a second rock, highlight the far side
steps.load: mix van dyke and dark sienna, then a touch of red
steps.rule: highlight goes on the side opposite the light source

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: detail water lines where the water spills
steps.motion: fine lines where the water comes off
steps.where: where the water spills off the wave

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: punch small holes in the foam
steps.motion: dab small holes into the foam
steps.new: looks like holes in the foam

steps.action: sign the painting
steps.load: thin red with paint thinner
